title: Hopfield Flip-Dots
blurb: A 960-disc flip-dot sign wired as a Hopfield network: its pictures live only in 460,320 wires. Scramble it and the discs clack back to the nearest memory, energy falling with every flip. Teach it five look-alike drawings with Hebb's rule and it settles on a ghost nobody stored; the projection rule brings the cat back.
